subject: Performance benchmark readout — slot availability & ops checklist
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acme-ai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Performance benchmark readout — scheduling

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for partnering with us on the load testing work. We'd like to schedule the benchmark readout / results review and run a short alignment session with engineering and ops. High-level asks: confirm token throughput targets (we're aiming for sustained 200k-300k tokens/sec across a 16-GPU pool), p99 latency targets at 8k context, and walk through the test harness/observability we should expect during the run.

Suggested week: Jun 26–30. Duration: 60–90 minutes. Prefer afternoons PT.

Can you share available slots and any pre-reads or an ops checklist we should review before the session? We'll need to invite our infra/ops and a couple of product folks.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Engineering Program Manager — Acme AI
elena.martinez@acme-ai.com
Acme AI

Attachments: none (will upload plan in followups)
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-06-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Performance benchmark readout — scheduling

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask. Happy to run the readout and ops walkthrough. A few quick questions so we prepare the right artifacts:

- Confirm model variant and max context length you want included in the readout (e.g., 8k vs 16k).
- Peak QPS expectations (approx concurrent requests) so we provision load generators appropriately.
- Any restricted data or redaction requirements for logs/screenshares.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Jun 27, 14:00–15:30
- Wed Jun 28, 14:00–15:00
- Thu Jun 29, 10:00–11:30

I've attached a short ops checklist and our suggested run cadence — please review and let us know which slot you prefer. If none work, tell us your preferred window and we'll try to accommodate.

I'll loop in Laura for infra/ops details and Karthik for test plan sign-off.

Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com

- We have a scheduled cluster maintenance window on Jun 28 22:00–02:00 PT (will not affect proposed afternoon slot).
- Ops can support the load generators and KV-cache warmup only if we have the final test dataset 48 hours prior.
- Recommend we reserve extra 30 minutes immediately after the readout for post-run log review (if there are regressions).

If Acme confirms Wed 6/28 14:00 PT, I'll spin up staging pools and post the runbook link here.
